     1→<!doctype html>
     2→<html lang="en">
     3→<head>
     4→<meta charset="utf-8">
     5→<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
     6→<title>Floral Green Funeral Program Template</title>
     7→
     8→<!-- Read by the build script to list this template in the picker. -->
     9→<meta name="mp-template" content="Floral Green">
    10→<meta name="mp-accent" content="#5c6b57">
    11→<meta name="mp-order" content="30">
    12→
    13→<!--
    14→  ASSETS (live in this folder, referenced relatively):
    15→    bg.jpg          full-page soft-green background with border + corner florals
    16→    image_frame.png eucalyptus wreath that overlays the circular photo
    17→
    18→  CONTRACT (same as every template in this system):
    19→  - Layout blocks: data-format="single" | "bifold" | "trifold".
    20→  - Editable spots: data-field="NAME". App swaps text; photo is data-field="photo"
    21→    filled via background-image.
    22→  - Shared field names carry across templates: headerLabel, photo, fullName, dates,
    23→    subtitleSmall, subtitle, obituary, pallbearers, orderOfService, acknowledgments,
    24→    poem, reflections, serviceDetails.
    25→  - Chrome (standalone-only) tagged data-mp-chrome. Panel widths FIXED in inches:
    26→    bifold 5.5in, trifold 3.6667in. Never flex.
    27→
    28→  PAIRED LISTS:
    29→  - orderOfService and pallbearers accept "Left | Right" per line and render as two
    30→    aligned columns (matches the reference). A line with no "|" is centered.
    31→  - A tiny inline script formats these; it also re-formats when the app injects new
    32→    text, so the app only ever needs to set plain textContent (with | separators).
    33→-->
    34→
    35→<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    36→<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    37→<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Great+Vibes&family=Poppins:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    38→
    39→<style>
    40→  :root{
    41→    --ink:#2c2c2c;
    42→    --muted:#5a5f55;
    43→    --script:"Great Vibes",cursive;
    44→    --sans:"Poppins",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
    45→  }
    46→  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
    47→  body{
    48→    margin:0;background:#d9ddd2;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);
    49→    -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact;
    50→  }
    51→
    52→  /* ---- standalone-only chrome ---- */
    53→  .mp-note{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);max-width:960px;margin:0 auto;padding:26px 20px 6px;line-height:1.5;}
    54→  .mp-caption{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);max-width:960px;margin:30px auto 10px;padding:0 20px;}
    55→  .stage{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 20px 60px;}
    56→
    57→  /* ---- sheets ---- */
    58→  .page,.spread{background:#eef2e8;box-shadow:0 3px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.18);overflow:hidden;position:relative;}
    59→  .page{width:8.5in;height:11in;}
    60→  .spread{width:11in;height:8.5in;display:flex;}
    61→  .panel{position:relative;}
    62→  .panel-bifold{width:5.5in;height:8.5in;}
    63→  .panel-trifold{width:3.6667in;height:8.5in;}
    64→  .spread .panel + .panel{border-left:1px dashed rgba(92,107,87,.5);}
    65→
    66→  /* background art */
    67→  .bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background-size:100% 100% !important;background:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center no-repeat;background-size:100% 100%;}
    68→  .panel .bg{background-size:100% 100%;}
    69→
    70→  .layer{position:absolute;inset:9.2% 8.6% 8.3% 9.3%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:space-evenly;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;}
    71→  .page .layer{padding:.12in .15in;}
    72→  .panel .layer{padding:.08in .1in;}
    73→  .panel-trifold .layer{padding:.05in .04in;}
    74→
    75→  /* ---- masthead ---- */
    76→  .mast{position:relative;width:100%;}
    77→  .mast .small{font-size:19pt;font-weight:400;color:#333;letter-spacing:.01em;line-height:1;margin-bottom:.16in;}
    78→  .mast .big{font-family:var(--script);font-size:72pt;line-height:1.18;color:#242424;margin-top:-2pt;}
    79→  .panel .mast .small{font-size:11pt;margin-bottom:.1in;}
    80→  .panel-trifold .mast .small{font-size:9.5pt;margin-bottom:.07in;}
    81→  .panel .mast .big{font-size:38pt;}
    82→  .panel-trifold .mast .big{font-size:26pt;}
    83→
    84→  /* ---- photo + wreath ---- */
    85→  .photo-wrap{position:relative;width:4.5in;aspect-ratio:1/1;margin:.16in 0;}
    86→  .panel-bifold .photo-wrap{width:3.1in;}
    87→  .panel-trifold .photo-wrap{width:2.5in;max-width:92%;}
    88→  .photo{position:absolute;inset:3.42% 1.74% 3.62% 5.30%;border-radius:50%;background:#e4ebdc center/cover no-repeat;
    89→    box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(90,95,85,.5);
    90→    background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,");}
    91→  .wreath{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
    92→    background:url("data:image/png;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;pointer-events:none;}
    93→
    94→  /* ---- names / dates / subtitle ---- */
    95→  .name{font-family:var(--script);font-size:48pt;line-height:1;color:#242424;margin:.05in 0 .02in;}
    96→  .panel-bifold .name{font-size:34pt;}
    97→  .panel-trifold .name{font-size:22pt;}
    98→  .dates{font-size:15.5pt;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#2f2f2f;margin:.04in 0 0;}
    99→  .panel .dates{font-size:11.5pt;}
   100→  .panel-trifold .dates{font-size:10pt;}
   101→  .sub-sm{font-size:14.5pt;font-weight:400;color:#333;margin:0 0 .02in;}
   102→  .sub{font-size:19pt;font-weight:600;color:#2b2b2b;}
   103→  .panel .sub-sm{font-size:10pt;margin-top:.18in;}
   104→  .panel .sub{font-size:13pt;}
   105→
   106→  /* ---- inside headings ---- */
   107→  .head{margin:0;}
   108→  .head .small{font-size:17pt;font-weight:400;color:#333;line-height:1;margin-bottom:.16in;}
   109→  .head .big{font-family:var(--script);font-size:54pt;line-height:1.18;color:#242424;}
   110→  .panel .head .small{font-size:11pt;margin-bottom:.1in;}
   111→  .panel-trifold .head .small{font-size:9pt;margin-bottom:.07in;}
   112→  .panel .head .big{font-size:30pt;}
   113→  .panel-trifold .head .big{font-size:22pt;}
   114→
   115→  .body{font-size:12pt;line-height:1.55;color:#333;text-align:center;margin:.06in .1in 0;white-space:pre-line;}
   116→  .panel-trifold .body{font-size:10pt;line-height:1.5;margin-top:.12in;}
   117→
   118→  .section{font-size:22pt;font-weight:600;color:#2b2b2b;margin:0 0 .1in;}
   119→  .panel .section{font-size:14pt;margin:0 0 .07in;}
   120→  .panel-trifold .section{font-size:12pt;margin:0 0 .05in;}
   121→
   122→  /* ---- paired two-column lists ---- */
   123→  .paired{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:.4in;row-gap:.02in;
   124→    font-size:14.5pt;color:#2f2f2f;width:100%;max-width:6.2in;}
   125→  .panel .paired{font-size:11pt;column-gap:.2in;}
   126→  .panel-trifold .paired{font-size:9.5pt;column-gap:.12in;line-height:1.5;}
   127→  .paired .pl{text-align:right;}
   128→  .paired .pr{text-align:left;color:#5c6b57;}
   129→  .paired .pc{grid-column:1 / -1;text-align:center;}
   130→
   131→  .group{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;}
   132→  .grow{flex:1 1 auto;}
   133→  .center-col{justify-content:space-evenly;}
   134→
   135→  @media print{
   136→    .page,.spread{zoom:1 !important;}
   137→    body{background:#fff;}
   138→    [data-mp-chrome]{display:none !important;}
   139→    .stage{padding:0;gap:0;}
   140→    .page,.spread{box-shadow:none;page-break-after:always;}
   141→  }
   142→</style>

   333→<script>
   334→/* Format paired "Left | Right" lists into two aligned columns.
   335→   Re-runs when the app injects new textContent, so the app only sets plain text. */
   336→(function(){
   337→  var busy=false;
   338→  function esc(s){return s.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;');}
   339→  function build(el){
   340→    if(!busy){
   341→      var t=(el.textContent||'').replace(/\u00a0/g,' ');
   342→      var cur=el.getAttribute('data-src');
   343→      if(t.trim() && t.trim()!==(cur||'').trim()){ el.setAttribute('data-src', t); }
   344→    }
   345→    var src=el.getAttribute('data-src');
   346→    if(src===null){ src=el.textContent; el.setAttribute('data-src', src); }
   347→    var rows=src.split('\n').map(function(l){return l.trim();}).filter(Boolean);
   348→    var html=rows.map(function(l){
   349→      var p=l.split('|');
   350→      if(p.length>1){ return '<span class="pl">'+esc(p[0].trim())+'</span><span class="pr">'+esc(p.slice(1).join('|').trim())+'</span>'; }
   351→      return '<span class="pc">'+esc(l)+'</span>';
   352→    }).join('');
   353→    busy=true; el.innerHTML=html; busy=false;
   354→  }
   355→  function init(){
   356→    var els=document.querySelectorAll('.paired');
   357→    els.forEach(build);
   358→    var mo=new MutationObserver(function(muts){
   359→      if(busy) return;
   360→      muts.forEach(function(m){
   361→        var t=m.target.classList&&m.target.classList.contains('paired')?m.target:
   362→              (m.target.parentElement&&m.target.parentElement.classList&&m.target.parentElement.classList.contains('paired')?m.target.parentElement:null);
   363→        if(t) build(t);
   364→      });
   365→    });
   366→    els.forEach(function(el){ mo.observe(el,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true}); });
   367→  }
   368→  if(document.readyState!=='loading') init();
   369→  else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
   370→})();
   371→</script>
   372→
   373→<script>
   374→/* Scale sheets down to fit narrow viewers so bifold/trifold spreads are never clipped. */
   375→(function(){
   376→  function fit(){
   377→    var pad=36;
   378→    document.querySelectorAll('.page,.spread').forEach(function(el){
   379→      var w = el.classList.contains('spread') ? el.offsetWidth/(parseFloat(el.style.zoom)||1) : el.offsetWidth/(parseFloat(el.style.zoom)||1);
   380→      // natural widths: page 8.5in=816px, spread 11in=1056px
   381→      var nat = el.classList.contains('spread') ? 1056 : 816;
   382→      var z = Math.min(1,(window.innerWidth-pad)/nat);
   383→      el.style.zoom = z;
   384→    });
   385→  }
   386→  window.addEventListener('resize', fit);
   387→  window.addEventListener('beforeprint', function(){
   388→    document.querySelectorAll('.page,.spread').forEach(function(el){ el.style.zoom=1; });
   389→  });
   390→  window.addEventListener('afterprint', fit);
   391→  if(document.readyState!=='loading') fit(); else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', fit);
   392→})();
   393→</script>
